successCriteria.description: ApprovalsPage.test.tsx asserts the queue renders each row with the employeeId truncated to its first 8 characters in a monospace style, the leave type code, the formatted start/end dates, and a detail link to /leaves/:requestId.
ApprovalsPage.test.tsx asserts the user-facing note "employee names require an API change" is visible in the rendered output.
ApprovalsPage.test.tsx asserts the explicit empty state ("nothing waiting on you") renders when getQueue() resolves to [] and is distinguishable from both the loading and error states.
ApprovalsPage.test.tsx asserts a loading state renders before the getQueue() promise resolves.
ApprovalsPage.test.tsx asserts an error state with role="alert" renders when getQueue() rejects.

ApprovalsPage.test.tsx asserts clicking Approve calls decide(requestId, 'approve') and replaces that row with the returned LeaveRequestView (new status visible, approve/reject controls gone) without re-fetching the queue.
ApprovalsPage.test.tsx asserts clicking Reject calls decide(requestId, 'reject').
ApprovalsPage.test.tsx asserts a decide() rejection surfaces the error state (role="alert").
DashboardPage.test.tsx asserts a link to /approvals is present when the signed-in user's role is MANAGER and when it is ADMIN, and absent when the role is EMPLOYEE.

constraints: The ApprovalsPage test fake must be an in-memory object cast to IApprovalsService imported from web/src/modules/approvals/index.ts — never a real ApprovalsService or a network call.
The dashboard link's role must be read from the already-fetched EmployeeProfile (via employeeService.getMe()) or from useAuth()'s session.profile — never decoded from the JWT token.
EmployeeRole must be imported from web/src/shared/types/index.ts; no local re-declaration of the enum or bare role string literals.
Tests use Vitest + @testing-library/react and live beside their subject (web/src/presentation/pages/), matching the established LeaveDetailPage.test.tsx / LeaveListPage.test.tsx style.
This phase is test + dashboard-link only: ApprovalsPage.tsx (Phase 4), the approvals service (Phase 1), and the route wiring are treated as fixed contracts and must not be modified.

ambiguities.description: DashboardPage.test.tsx does not currently exist, so the phase's "extend/add coverage" instruction is ambiguous between creating a new test file vs. extending an existing one.
options: Create a new DashboardPage.test.tsx covering the role-gated link (and optionally existing dashboard rendering)
Create a new file covering only the role-gated link

ambiguities.description: The dashboard role source is specified as "employeeService.getMe() OR useAuth()" — the implementation may choose either, but the test must match whichever the page actually uses.
options: Read role from the EmployeeProfile already fetched via employeeService.getMe()

entityInvariants.invariant: A queue row rendered from an ApprovalsQueueItem shows employeeId truncated to 8 characters in monospace, leaveTypeCode, formatted start/end dates, and a detail link; its status is always LeaveStatus.SUBMITTED while pending and employeeName is always null (never rendered as a name).

After a successful decide, the row is replaced in place with the returned LeaveRequestView: the new status is visible and the approve/reject controls are removed for that row, without re-fetching the queue.
The /approvals link is rendered only when profile.role is EmployeeRole.MANAGER or EmployeeRole.ADMIN; an EmployeeRole.EMPLOYEE profile never renders it.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: A rejection propagates to the page and renders the error state (role="alert"); an empty array is a normal condition rendered as the explicit empty state, never an error.
On success the returned LeaveRequestView replaces the pending row in place (no re-fetch); on rejection the error state (role="alert") is surfaced.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The ApprovalsPage test fake must satisfy the IApprovalsService interface (getQueue + decide with the ApprovalDecision action union) exactly as declared in the approvals module's public entry point.
The rendered ApprovalsPage behavior under test (8-char monospace employeeId, note text, empty/loading/error states, decide row replacement) must match the Phase 4 ApprovalsPage implementation.
The dashboard link role gate must read role from the EmployeeProfile already fetched via employeeService.getMe() (or useAuth()'s session.profile), matching the existing DashboardPage data flow.
EmployeeRole enum values (EMPLOYEE/MANAGER/ADMIN) must be imported from the shared types module, not re-declared.
Test style (Vitest, @testing-library/react, in-memory fakes cast to the interface, MemoryRouter, findByRole/fireEvent/waitFor) must follow the established page-test conventions.

integrationPoints.why: The ApprovalsPage test fake is cast to this interface; the page under test consumes it.
Role gating and test fixtures reuse the canonical enums/types.
The dashboard role is read from the profile these already expose; no JWT decoding.
